ios.desc:
Clouder is a professional-grade client for Cloudflare, built for developers, system administrators, and DevOps teams on iPhone and iPad. Not affiliated with Cloudflare®.

Manage your Cloudflare resources from anywhere with a fast, native experience.

WORKERS & PAGES
View Worker logs, monitor execution metrics, and manage scripts on the go. Browse Pages projects, review deployments, and track build status.

DNS MANAGEMENT
Add, edit, and delete DNS records across your zones. Filter by type and proxy status, manage zone settings, and view analytics with native charts. Set up Email Routing rules with a catch-all address, and balance traffic across origin pools with Load Balancing health monitors.

STORAGE & DATABASES
Manage your data layer with support for R2, D1, and KV. Upload and download files in R2, run SQL queries in D1, and browse or edit KV namespaces.

STREAM & IMAGES
Upload and manage Stream videos, monitor live inputs, and review playback analytics. Organize Images and manage variants.

ZERO TRUST & TUNNELS
Monitor Access applications, Gateway rules, posture policies, and connected devices. Create and manage Tunnels, routes, and tokens.

ANALYTICS & MONITORING
Track traffic, bandwidth, requests, and security threats with interactive charts. See detailed insights for zones, Workers, Stream, and D1 in real time. Follow privacy-first Web Analytics with page views, visits, Core Web Vitals, and breakdowns by country, referrer, browser, and device.

CLOUDER AGENT
Ask the Clouder Agent about your account in plain language. It reads your zones, DNS, traffic, security settings, Workers, Pages, and storage to answer questions, and it can act for you, creating or updating DNS records, purging cache, or setting the security level. It always asks for approval before it writes anything.

BRING YOUR OWN TOKEN
Sign in with a Cloudflare API token scoped to exactly the permissions you choose. Clouder shows what your token covers and lets you re-check or replace it later without signing out.

QUEUES & DURABLE OBJECTS
Manage Queues with push, pull, and purge actions. Browse Durable Objects namespaces and inspect active instances.

WAF & SECURITY
Monitor firewall events, manage rulesets, and configure protections. Tune SSL/TLS modes, edge certificates, and the minimum TLS version, and stop bots with Turnstile widgets.

quotes.text:
I've been working on a native iOS app called Clouder. The goal is to provide a better experience than the mobile web dashboard for managing your infrastructure on the go.

The app supports a wide range of services. You can manage Compute resources like Workers deployments, Pages projects, Durable Objects, and Queues. It connects to your Storage and Data to let you query D1 databases, browse R2 buckets, and manage KV namespaces. It also handles Media features like Stream and Images, as well as AI products like Vectorize and Workers AI.

For general networking, you can manage DNS records, Tunnels, WAF rules, and view Zone analytics. The app supports multi-account setups, includes home screen widgets for traffic and database stats, and is localized in five languages. You log in directly using your Cloudflare API token.

I'd appreciate any feedback or feature requests.
